scope: Tomoshi/JMdict entries marked common, compared to complete runtime teacher audit at JMdict entry-ID level

policy.variantDeduplication: If any exact runtime form+reading resolves to the same JMdict entry ID, the lemma is covered; alternate spellings are not reported as missing words.
policy.ambiguity: Ambiguous runtime homographs conservatively cover every matching entry ID to prevent false-positive additions.
policy.publication: Report only; no candidate is automatically added to runtime vocabulary.
policy.meaning: Traditional Chinese meaning must resolve through Tomoshi zh-TW for the same JMdict entry ID.
